verdict.rationale: Kong publishes a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its own APIs (kong-docs-9) and its Dev Portal explicitly supports publishing APIs via OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs (kong-docs-49), showing machine-readable spec support is a core capability. However, a direct probe of the main docs site found no discoverable openapi.json/swagger.json at expected well-known paths (kong-probe-2), so a user cannot trivially download a single canonical machine-readable spec without navigating to the dedicated API directory. missing for 10: a verified downloadable spec file at a standard/well-known endpoint, independent confirmation that the OpenAPI directory contains complete/valid specs, and evidence of AsyncAPI or MCP-tool spec export for AI-agent consumption.
